title: Warm Nutty Vietnamese Beef Pho Bo
description: A hearty and comforting Vietnamese beef noodle soup made with a rich beef broth, rare steak, and chewy noodles, perfect for a lazy Sunday

ingredients.name: beef bones
ingredients.notes: preferably oxtail or beef neck bones

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit
Roast the beef bones in the oven for 30 minutes
In a large pot, combine the roasted beef bones, onion, ginger, star anise, and cinnamon sticks
Pour in 4 quarts of water and bring to a boil
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 1 hour
Strain the broth through a fine-mesh sieve and discard the solids
Add the fish sauce to the broth and stir to combine
Cook the rice noodles according to the package instructions
Slice the rare steak into thin strips and add to the hot broth
Assemble the pho by placing some noodles into a bowl, then adding slices of steak and ladling the hot broth over the top
